description:
¿Quiénes somos? 




Clivi es la primera startup en México enfocada en mejorar la vida de personas con enfermedades crónicas como diabetes, sobrepeso y obesidad, las principales causas de muerte en México y Latinoamérica.




Somos la empresa de salud digital de mayor crecimiento en México: hemos atendido a más de 17 mil pacientes. Fuimos la primera compañía digital en México en trabajar con los dos titanes del GLP-1 en el mundo. Nuestra misión es simple pero poderosa: llevar salud de calidad a quienes más lo necesitan.




La posición 




No buscamos un perfil. Buscamos solo a alguien extraordinari@.




Te vamos a dar problemas reales del negocio, no tareas. Un funnel que no convierte. Un canal que nadie ha probado, una línea de negocio que lanzar, etc.. Un proceso manual que se come 40 horas a la semana del equipo. Tu trabajo es entender el problema, construir la solución (con código, con IA, con lo que haga falta) y medir si funcionó. Luego el siguiente.




Serás un builder: un mes estarás automatizando el seguimiento de leads con agentes de IA, el siguiente lanzando un experimento de adquisición, el siguiente construyendo el dashboard de automatizado de una nueva línea de negocio que tú mismo@ lanzaste. Trabajarás directamente con los fundadores.




¿Qué harás con nosotros? 




Tomar proyectos de growth de principio a fin: diagnóstico, solución, lanzamiento y medición.
Construir herramientas internas, automatizaciones y agentes de IA que hagan que el equipo se mueva 10x más rápido.

Construiste algo real. Una app, un bot, una herramienta, un negocio, un proyecto open source. Algo que otras personas usaron, que generó dinero o que resolvió un problema real. Muéstranos el link, el repo o los números. Este es el requisito más importante.

No aceptas un no por respuesta. Eres hustler, emprendedor@, survivor. Si una puerta se cierra, encuentras la ventana.
Piensas en primeros principios: entiendes el problema antes de saltar a la solución.
Tiene ambición para ganar, y ganas de construir la compañía de salud digital más grande de LATAM. (competir y ganar) 
Te comunicas bien en inglés, oral y escrito.




Suma puntos 




Ganaste hackathons, olimpiadas de matemáticas o programación, o competencias similares.
Ya emprendiste, aunque haya fracasado. Sobre todo si fracasó y sabes por qué.
Tienes seguidores, usuarios o clientes que puedes nombrar.




Esto no es para todos 




Seremos honestos: esto no es un trabajo de 9 a 6. Trabajamos con intensidad de fundador. Hay semanas largas y fines de semana en los que un lanzamiento no puede esperar. Buscamos gente que quiera estar en la oficina porque ahí está la acción, que se obsesione con sus proyectos y que no pueda dormir hasta resolverlos. Si buscas comodidad, este no es tu lugar. Si buscas aprender en 2 años lo que otros aprenden en 10, sí.

Equity. La gente extraordinaria debe ser dueña de su empresa. Para parecerlo hay que serlo: tendrás acciones de Clivi.

At Ultimate Jet Vacations, email is more than a channel, it’s one of our most powerful revenue engines. It’s how we nurture travelers from first click to confirmed booking, and how we keep them coming back.

We’re looking for an Email Marketing Specialist who will own the strategy, execution, and performance of our email programs in HubSpot. Lifecycle & CRM Strategy

You will own and evolve UJV’s CRM ecosystem within HubSpot, building scalable segmentation and lifecycle strategies that move advisors from new leads to highly engaged, high-value partners. You’ll continuously improve audience targeting, engagement scoring, and database health to maximize conversion opportunities.

Email Marketing & Campaign Execution

You will build and execute high-performing email campaigns across nurture flows, co-op campaigns, re-engagement sequences, and conversion-focused initiatives. You understand how to balance strategy with flawless execution, ensuring campaigns are timely, relevant, and aligned with business priorities.

Segmentation & Personalization

You will develop sophisticated segmentation strategies based on advisor behavior, engagement history, booking trends, and destination interests. You know personalization goes beyond “first name” tokens, and you understand how to make every campaign feel intentional and relevant.

Automation & Funnel Development

You will create scalable automated workflows that support long-term growth, including onboarding journeys, nurture sequences, re-engagement campaigns, and conversion funnels. You think beyond one-off sends and build systems that continuously move advisors through the lifecycle.

Performance, Optimization & AI-Powered Growth

You will own email performance reporting and optimization, tracking metrics such as engagement, conversion, pipeline contribution, and campaign ROI. You’re naturally analytical and constantly testing, iterating, and improving. We leverage AI to move faster, and you’ll use AI-powered tools to improve targeting, messaging, efficiency, and performance insights.

High-performance mindset and drive. Our culture is strongly based on results.

Significant expansion of email subscriber lists

You’re a data-driven email marketing pro who thrives in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.

You don’t just send emails, you understand the story behind the numbers and use it to make every campaign smarter than the last.

You’re equally comfortable building a complex HubSpot workflow, writing a subject line that earns the open, and presenting performance results to stakeholders.

You’re creative, analytical, and accountable, and you take ownership of your revenue targets as if they were your own.

As Email Marketing Specialist, you’ll have direct ownership of a channel that drives millions in revenue for UJV. You’ll work closely with the Marketing team, designers, content creators, and Sales to shape how we engage travelers across their entire journey.

If you’re excited about combining creativity, data, and HubSpot mastery to deliver measurable results, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact.

description:
Job Description

About us

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Purpose of the Role

Regional content studios are part of MOM's regional hubs, helping markets deliver the right content faster through greater reuse, better coordination and consistent ways of working. They focus primarily on adapting global content for local markets, while supporting local brand content where needed, using the tools, capabilities and processes defined by the central team. Diageo teams lead the studio, while agency partners deliver creative adaptation and production.

The Regional Content Operations Lead manages content demand and delivery for assigned categories across markets. This role is the day-to-day link between market and brand teams and the agency delivery team, reviewing briefs, challenging low-value requests, maximising reuse, choosing the right delivery route and ensuring assets are delivered on time and ready for approval, storage and reuse.

Key Accountabilities


Manage content demand and delivery for assigned categories, with a primary focus on adapting GBT assets for market use.
Review and clarify briefs from markets and brand teams, challenging unclear, duplicated or low-value asks and improving briefing quality over time.
Check for reuse before production and decide the most efficient route: reuse, GBT asset adaptation, Pencil/AI production, agency production or new-to-world only where truly needed.
Translate market needs into clear agency briefs, including assets, formats, mandatories, timelines, approval needs, delivery route and creative direction.
Guide the agency on workflows, templates, production approach and adaptation requirements, reviewing outputs where needed to ensure they are fit for purpose.
Track status, risks and missing inputs through the Planning & Briefing Platform, escalating issues and ensuring final assets are ready for approval, storage, tagging and reuse.


Key Competencies


 Brand Proposition
 Brand Activation


Qualifications And Experience Required


CONTENT DELIVERY EXPERIENCE: 6+ years of experience in content delivery, creative operations, marketing operations, agency account management, brand management, production or regional marketing.
CREATIVE JUDGMENT: Strong in-house or creative agency background, with the ability to understand briefs, judge outputs, provide clear feedback and bridge brand teams and agency partners.
BRIEFING & ADAPTATION EXPERTISE: Strong understanding of content briefing, reuse, adaptation, production workflows, approval requirements and market delivery needs.
AI & TOOL KNOWLEDGE: Good working knowledge of AI-enabled production, Pencil or similar tools, DAM/Libraries and content planning platforms.
PROJECT MANAGEMENT: Able to manage multiple briefs, deadlines, stakeholders and agency workflows at the same time.
PUSHBACK & EXECUTION: Detail-oriented and confident challenging weak briefs or unnecessary new creation, with focus on speed, reuse, cost efficiency, quality and market service.


Diversity Statement

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.

We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.

Recruitment Scam Warning

Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.

Solicitar la hoja de vida y documentos anexos para su evaluación.

IV. Medidas de Seguridad 

RSI se compromete a salvaguardar la confidencialidad de sus Datos Personales; por tanto, en cumplimiento a las políticas corporativas y a lo establecido en la Ley, RSI mantiene las medidas de seguridad necesarias con el fin de proteger las bases de datos y para evitar su pérdida, alteración, destrucción, uso, acceso o tratamiento no autorizado.

V. Ejercicio de Derechos

Usted podrá en cualquier momento, (i) acceder a los datos personales que obren en poder de RSI, (ii) rectificarlos cuando sean inexactos o incompletos, inadecuados, excesivos, siempre y cuando no resulte imposible o exija esfuerzos desproporcionados, (iii) oponerse al tratamiento de los datos personales por causa legítima, (iv) cancelarlos, salvo cuando pudiese causar perjuicios a derechos o intereses legítimos de terceros o en los casos previstos por la Ley, (v) a limitar su uso y divulgación, y (vi) revocar su consentimiento (aunque esto podría no ser procedente o significar la terminación de la relación laboral).

Head of Customer Success & Product

High-Growth EdTech Startup | Remote | Full-Time

Work Directly with the CEO & Founder | Potential Path to COO




🌱 About the Company

The company's mission is to unlock every student's potential. We believe every student deserves the opportunity to succeed, regardless of their past academic performance or circumstances.

The business has grown from approximately $400K to $3M in annual revenue in a remarkably short period, with the ambition of positively impacting millions of students.




🚀 The Opportunity

We're looking for an entrepreneurial, energetic, and resourceful leader who combines a founder's mindset with strong operational and people leadership skills.

Working directly with the CEO and Founder, you'll lead and scale Customer Success, Student Success, Product, and customer-facing systems, ensuring an outstanding experience for schools while improving operations and technology.

You'll collaborate closely with the Head of Logistics & Tutor Success and technical leadership to drive execution across the business.

We're looking for a builder, not just a manager. Someone proactive, hands-on, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by building processes, solving problems, and scaling a fast-growing startup. This is a high-ownership environment that requires flexibility and a willingness to go the extra mile when the business needs it.

The role offers significant growth potential, including a possible path toward Head of Operations or COO.




🎯 What You'll Lead

1. Customer Success & Student Outcomes

Build and lead Customer Success and Student Success, from onboarding through retention, renewals, and expansion.
Develop scalable customer communication, health tracking, and risk management processes.
Improve customer satisfaction, engagement, and student outcomes.
Coordinate with academic, logistics, and tutor teams to ensure service quality.

2. Product Management & Innovation

Lead Product in partnership with the CEO, translating business and customer needs into priorities.
Manage product roadmaps, requirements, UAT, launches, and adoption.
Work with engineering and technical leadership to improve the platform and customer experience.
Establish feedback loops between customers, Product, and internal teams.

3. Process Improvement, AI & Automation

Identify inefficiencies and redesign workflows to reduce manual work and operational complexity.
Implement AI tools, agents, and automations across customer-facing and internal processes.
Build scalable solutions that support growth without proportional increases in headcount.
Measure the impact of improvements while ensuring reliability, human oversight, and data protection.

4. HubSpot, CRM & Customer Systems

Own and optimize CRM processes, preferably using HubSpot.
Build workflows, automations, reporting, and customer lifecycle tracking.
Improve Sales-to-Customer-Success handoffs, customer health monitoring, renewals, and expansion processes.
Drive CRM adoption and data quality across teams.

5. Data & Analytics

Develop dashboards, KPIs, and performance scorecards.
Monitor retention, engagement, student outcomes, product adoption, and operational efficiency.
Turn data into actionable insights and measurable improvements.

6. People Leadership & Execution

Hire, coach, and develop high-performing Customer Success and Product teams.
Build a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Establish clear priorities, performance expectations, and operating rhythms.
Lead cross-functional initiatives and empower teams to work autonomously.




👤 Who We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

5+ years of Customer Success experience, including leadership, or equivalent entrepreneurial experience as a Founder/Co-Founder managing customers, service delivery, teams, and business operations.
Proven experience building and leading teams.
Hands-on experience using AI tools, agents, and workflow automation to improve business efficiency.
Strong track record in process improvement and building scalable systems.
Analytical skills and experience using KPIs to drive decisions.
Experience with CRM platforms; HubSpot is preferred but not required.
Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
Entrepreneurial mindset, adaptability, and comfort in fast-paced startup environments.
Genuine passion for education, social impact, and helping students succeed.

Strongly Preferred

Experience in EdTech, B2B, or B2B SaaS.
Previous Head/Director of Customer Success experience.
Founder, Co-Founder, or early-stage startup experience.
Experience leading Product, Product Operations, or customer-facing technology initiatives.
Advanced HubSpot knowledge and experience implementing AI agents.
Experience scaling teams and operations in high-growth environments.




Additional Advantages

Background in K-12 education, tutoring, or working with school districts.
Experience as a teacher, tutor, or educator.
Involvement in nonprofits, social enterprises, volunteering, or mission-driven organizations.
Experience in marketplaces or tech-enabled services.

We're looking for an energetic, charismatic, and purpose-driven leader who loves working with people, takes ownership, and thrives in fast-paced startup environments. Someone proactive, hands-on, eager to grow, and genuinely passionate about the company's mission and making a meaningful impact on students' lives.

And every solution is backed by real humans who actually give a sh*t about helping restaurants succeed.


Named the #1 Restaurant POS by G2 (Summer 2026), based on ratings from real users
Rated the top-rated point-of-sale (POS) for restaurants, bars, retail, and small businesses by Capterra users
Awarded Great Places to Work and Built In’s Best Workplaces for multiple years running


We move fast, care hard, and fight for independent restaurant operators to do what they love, and love doing it. If you’re looking to make an impact with heart and hustle, SpotOn is the place for you.

About The Role

As a Client Onboarding Specialist, you will play a critical role in ensuring a seamless and strategic Point of Sale (POS) implementation experience for our enterprise and mid-market clients (5+ locations). Serving as a trusted advisor, you will take ownership of the entire onboarding journey, from initial engagement to successful activation, ensuring that all system elements are configured, integrated, and optimized for client operations. This role requires a high level of project management, stakeholder coordination, and technical expertise to drive efficiency and ensure client satisfaction. Your success will be measured by key performance indicators, including time-to-install, activation rates, and overall client experience (NPS/CSAT).

What You'll Do


Lead onboarding consultations with key decision-makers, aligning expectations, defining success metrics, and establishing implementation roadmaps.
Serve as the primary contact for executive stakeholders, ensuring proactive communication and alignment throughout onboarding.
Identify and mitigate potential roadblocks, coordinating with internal teams and escalating when needed to maintain momentum.
Partner with Success and Support teams to ensure smooth post-installation transitions and long-term client adoption.
Conduct detailed configuration calls, aligning system setup with complex multi-location operations and client workflows.
Collaborate with Engineering, Sales, and Implementation teams to manage custom integrations and system optimizations.
Ensure technical components are thoroughly tested and validated to minimize go-live risks.
Manage onboarding timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and client expectations to drive efficient implementations.
Maintain comprehensive documentation in CRM and project management tools for team visibility.
Develop and refine onboarding playbooks, using data and client feedback to enhance processes.
Consistently meet or exceed KPIs, including time-to-install, activation rates, and NPS/CSAT scores.
Analyze onboarding performance trends to identify operational efficiencies and improve client outcomes.
Lead internal training and contribute to knowledge-sharing initiatives to strengthen team capabilities.
Deliver high-quality, accurate work and outcomes by consistently adhering to documented processes, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and checklists.
Review and verify outcomes before submission to maintain consistency and high-quality standards.
Identify and address process gaps or errors to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.


What You'll Need


Deep expertise in restaurant technology, POS platforms, and operational best practices.
Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills, engaging senior stakeholders to drive alignment.
Advanced proficiency in virtual training, remote onboarding, and implementation best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a strategic approach to complex client needs.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and manage competing priorities in fast-paced environments.
Experienced with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce), project management tools, and data-driven reporting.
Knowledge of restaurant operations, enterprise hospitality solutions, or related industries.
Experienced implementing or supporting enterprise POS solutions for multi-location clients.
Skilled in client-facing project management or onboarding, managing complex rollouts successfully.
2 – 5 years of professional experience in customer success or related roles.
Experience in fintech or SaaS environments preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field required.
An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
Fluent in English and Spanish (written and verbal).

From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. Experience with programmatic onboarding and building automation/runbooks.

description:
About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We are looking for a customer-focused and analytically-minded individual to be a member of our Mexico City office on the Sustainability data advisory team. This is an opportunity to join a core team at a growth-stage start-up that works with the world's top companies to accelerate their sustainability programs. You'll work directly with customers as a trusted advisor, leading measurement sessions and delivering advisory services that unlock the full value of our platform — enabling our customers to gain clear, reliable insights into their sustainability impact and achieve their sustainability goals.

You will:


Advise sustainability teams at many of the world’s top companies. You’ll work directly with customers on how to measure actionable carbon and non-carbon footprints to reach sustainability goals and enable real reductions, ranging from scoping new measurements to in-depth methodology comparisons between footprints. 
Deliver services that accelerate customer success, helping customers set up their measurements to meet sustainability goals, serving as a trusted partner in emissions verifications, and providing specialized advisory to optimize their data and methodologies. You'll ensure customers unlock maximum value from Watershed's platform faster and more effectively than they could on their own. 
Collaborate with science, engineering, and product teams to pioneer innovative measurement solutions and expand Watershed's sustainability intelligence layer. 


You might be a fit if you:


Have 4-6 years of experience in a consulting, solutions-engineering, or other customer-facing role. You are excited to work directly with customers to help them set the foundation for world-class sustainability programs. 
Have experience in sustainability-related fields, greenhouse gas accounting and/or ESG reporting. 
Are an excellent verbal and written communicator. You can communicate complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences. 
Learn quickly and operate well in ambiguity. You are organized, systematic, and efficient. You thrive in a high-volume environment. 
Think clearly about complex problems, and are comfortable using and speaking to data. You are meticulous and detail-obsessed. 
Are passionate about solving climate change and excited to contribute to doing so at a fast-paced startup. 
Have strong English language proficiency


This position is required to be in person in our Mexico City office 4 days per week.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

As Digital Marketing Specialist, you will manage the operational and creative execution of digital marketing campaigns, ensuring that every channel and customer touchpoint is properly configured, consistent, and optimized. Your responsibilities will include:

Moderate live webinars, ensuring smooth technical delivery and strong audience engagement. 
Write, edit, and implement conversational copy for ManyChat chatbot automations. 
Build, configure, and optimize trigger-based automated chatbot flows. 
Research and evaluate promotional channels, identify suitable placement opportunities, and communicate with channel administrators. 
Create and proofread persuasive promotional copy for channel placements and seeding campaigns. 
Track campaign activity and results in spreadsheets, monitoring performance and conversion rates. 
Write, configure, and manage email marketing campaigns and automated sequences.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented digital marketing professional who combines strong copywriting skills with hands-on technical execution. title: Senior Revops Engineer
description:
About Improvado Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams.

We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI.

Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies.

You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured.

That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from.

You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change.

You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do Salesforce and GTM stack Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).

Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes.

Manage licences and vendor renewals.

Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.

Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance.

Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.

Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).

Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.

Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes.

Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.

Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.

Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product.

Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands‑on admin of a live Salesforce org.

Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric).

dbt is a plus.

Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.

Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.

Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.

Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.

ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.

Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.

Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.

HubSpot to Salesforce migration.

Attribution or CS health score data.

Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer Remote-first environment Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises 20 working days of PTO per year US holidays and additional days off Professional development reimbursement

title: Sr. Performance Media Planner
skills: Traducir objetivos de negocio del cliente (ventas, nuevos clientes, CAC, ROAS, LTV) en planes de medios de performance con KPIs claros y alcanzables.
Diseñar planes full-funnel para ecosistemas D2C: adquisición, consideración, remarketing y retención, en Google, Meta, TikTok, DSP , etc.
Definir mix de canales, distribución de presupuesto, audiencias, calendario y escenarios de inversión vs. resultado.
Ser responsable del cumplimiento de los KPIs del plan: dar seguimiento semanal, detectar desviaciones y acordar con el Trader las acciones correctivas.
Anticipar riesgos antes y durante la campaña (tracking, pacing, estacionalidad, inventario, saturación de audiencias, creatividad) y proponer soluciones antes de que impacten resultados.
Diseñar una agenda de test & learn: pruebas A/B, nuevos formatos, canales y estudios de incrementalidad.
Convertir datos en historias de negocio: análisis de resultados, insights y recomendaciones para QBRs y reportes al cliente.
Coordinar con equipos de trading, creatividad, analítica y CRM, y con socios de plataformas.
Licenciatura en Mercadotecnia, Comunicación, Administración, Economía o afín.
3 a 5 años de experiencia en planeación de medios digitales con foco en performance, idealmente en agencia.
Experiencia comprobable con marcas D2C, e-commerce o retail.
Conocimiento del rol de cada canal en el funnel: Google (Search, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube), Meta, TikTok y programática.
Dominio de KPIs de e-commerce y negocio: CPA, CAC, ROAS, AOV, tasa de conversión, LTV y abandono de carrito.
Entendimiento de modelos de atribución, medición de incrementalidad y lectura de GA4.
Inglés intermedio-avanzado.

description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Managing Consultant, Advisors & Consulting Services, Marketing

ADVISORS & CONSULTING SERVICES

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution. Our Advisors & Consulting Services team combines traditional management consulting with Mastercard’s rich data assets, proprietary platforms, and technologies to provide clients with powerful strategic insights and recommendations. Our teams work with a diverse global customer base across industries, from banking and payments to retail and restaurants.

The Advisors & Consulting Services group has five specializations: Strategy & Transformation, Performance Analytics, Business Experimentation, Marketing, and Program Management. Our Marketing consultants lead the strategy development and implementation of campaigns and engagements for clients. They use customer data to provide deep direct marketing expertise across channels, evaluating campaign results and adapting the approach to optimize marketing performance.

Positions for different specializations and levels are available in separate job postings. Please review our consulting specializations to learn more about all opportunities and apply for the position that is best suited to your background and experience: https://careers.mastercard.com/us/en/consulting-specializations-at-mastercard

Envision this role as the pivot in a thrilling marketing services transformation. It's about fully embracing and fueling change while seamlessly balancing traditional marketing endeavors. This profile thrives in a dynamic environment, contributing ideas, and actively steering this transformational journey.

Roles And Responsibilities

Client Impact

description:
Descripción de la empresa

Publicis Groupe México es una destacada agencia de publicidad y comunicación integral que ofrece

soluciones creativas y estratégicas en marketing digital, medios y relaciones públicas. Parte del

conglomerado global Publicis Groupe, se especializa en innovar y conectar marcas con sus audiencias a

través de campañas efectivas y tecnología avanzada.

Descripción del puesto

Apoyar en la implementación, seguimiento, optimización y cierre de campañas de medios, asegurando el cumplimiento de los planes aprobados, el control administrativo de la inversión y la entrega puntual de reportes. La posición coordina actividades con equipos internos, clientes, plataformas y proveedores para mantener una operación ordenada y orientada a resultados.

Responsabilidades

No necesitas ser experto en medios. Si tienes potencial y las bases que buscamos, nuestro equipo te ayudará a desarrollar los conocimientos necesarios.

Enfoque de la vacante: Principalmente medios offline, más que online.

Implementar campañas de medios digitales y, cuando aplique, apoyar ejecuciones integradas con medios tradicionales.

Dar seguimiento a presupuestos, pacing, calendarios, materiales, especificaciones y entregables de campaña.

Cargar y actualizar órdenes de compra, planes, modificaciones y cierres en sistemas internos o ERP de medios.

Coordinar solicitudes con plataformas, publishers, proveedores, equipos de planeación, finanzas y servicio al cliente.

Monitorear KPIs de campaña e identificar desviaciones u oportunidades de optimización para escalar al supervisor.

Preparar, validar y actualizar reportes de campaña, post-buy, bases de competencia y presentaciones de resultados.

Asegurar la precisión de la información en sistemas, reportes y controles administrativos.

Dar seguimiento a conciliaciones, facturación, documentación y cierres de inversión con proveedores y equipos internos.

Participar en reuniones de estatus y comunicar riesgos, pendientes y avances de manera clara y oportuna.

Cumplir procesos, tiempos y estándares de calidad, respondiendo con agilidad ante cambios de prioridad

Cualificaciones

Licenciatura concluida en Mercadotecnia, Publicidad, Comunicación, Administración o carrera afín.

1 a 3 años de experiencia en agencia de medios, publicidad, marketing o áreas relacionadas.

Experiencia en implementación, seguimiento y cierre de campañas.

Manejo intermedio de Excel y PowerPoint; capacidad para trabajar con bases de datos, reportes y presentaciones.

Información adicional

En Publicis Groupe valoramos la diversidad y estamos comprometidos con la creación de un entorno de trabajo inclusivo para todas las personas. No discriminamos por motivos de raza, color, religión, sexo, identidad o expresión de género, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad, estado civil, nacionalidad o cualquier otra condición protegida por la ley.

Creemos que la diversidad impulsa la innovación y fortalece nuestros equipos. Por ello, promovemos la igualdad de oportunidades y tomamos todas las decisiones de empleo con base en las capacidades, experiencia, mérito y necesidades del negocio, garantizando siempre un trato respetuoso y digno para colaboradores y candidatos.

Asimismo, reconocemos la importancia de la flexibilidad laboral y promovemos un esquema de trabajo híbrido que permite combinar el trabajo remoto y presencial, favoreciendo el bienestar de nuestros colaboradores sin comprometer la excelencia en el servicio que brindamos a nuestros clientes.

Scope of Ownership: Take end-to-end accountability for campaign setup, tracking, pacing, optimization, post-campaign analysis, and incremental revenue growth.
Portfolio Ownership: Own and grow a dedicated portfolio of agency and holding group accounts, acting as the day-to-day reference for Sales, clients and internal teams on every campaign within it.

Impact Metric: Success in this role means achieving full campaign delivery within SLAs, maintaining high client satisfaction, and driving upsell opportunities through actionable insights and performance data.
Provide RFP strategy to ensure storytelling is consistent across all departments, including creating client presentations, media plans, and inventory forecasts.
Introduce new products strategically in line with commercial and operational guidelines.
Partner with Sales on pre-sale client communications and technical requirements.
Lead kick-off calls for upcoming campaign launches with agency and client stakeholders across all activation types (Managed Service, Self Service, and Programmatic Deal IDs).
Onboard clients to our self-service buying platform, guiding them through feature adoption and campaign setup.
Serve as the lead point of contact for all client communications following the sale, maintaining clear and concise alignment prior to activation.
Oversee post-sale operations, including campaign setup, pacing, delivery, site list requests, and post-campaign analysis.
Optimize proactively by monitoring pacing, delivery, viewability and performance KPIs, anticipating risks and recommending changes (site lists, formats, targeting) before they become client issues.

Manage ad serving and verification setups, including third-party tags, VAST, and brand safety and viewability measurement, and troubleshoot discrepancies across ad servers, DSPs and verification vendors.
Set up and monitor programmatic deals (PMPs, PG, Deal IDs) across the DSPs our clients buy through, coordinating with agencies and Ad Operations.
Delegate and partner effectively with Associate Campaign Managers and Ad Operations teams for tagging, site tracking, reporting, screenshots, and availability pulls.
Analyze campaign performance data to highlight key trends and surface actionable insights for clients.

Deliver Final Reports, QBR/YBR inputs and ad-hoc analyses on agreed deadlines, keeping every request logged in our team tracker (Monday) with clear owners and dates, and renegotiating timelines transparently when needed.
Lead client workshops and deep dives on topics such as viewability, brand safety and campaign performance, translating technical data into clear messages for non-technical audiences.
Support commercial analyses (CPM, site-level costs and margin) on key accounts, helping Sales and leadership balance client goals with profitability.
Document client-specific exceptions, processes and learnings in shared team tools so any account can be covered seamlessly.
Plan and execute quarterly incremental revenue prospecting plans in close collaboration with the Sales team.
Contribute to internal team development through consistent knowledge sharing and operational best practice exercises.
Core Experience: 2 to 3+ years of relevant experience within a digital media agency, publisher, SSP, DSP, or AdTech company.
Programmatic Ecosystem: Solid understanding of the programmatic ecosystem (SSPs, DSPs, ad exchanges, deal types and how the pieces connect) and of tactical systems such as Salesforce.
DSPs: Working knowledge of multiple DSPs (e.g., DV360, The Trade Desk) and of how campaigns and deals are set up, paced and optimized in each.
Ad Servers: Understanding of how third-party ad servers work: tagging, trafficking, VAST, tracking and discrepancy troubleshooting.
Brand Safety & Verification: Familiarity with the verification environment (e.g., IAS, DV, MOAT) and how brand safety, viewability and fraud measurement affect delivery and reporting.

Organization & Time Management: Highly organized, with a proven track record of managing competing priorities and balancing big-picture plans with daily execution detail across multiple campaigns in a fast-paced environment.
Proactivity & Ownership: A self-starter who anticipates issues, flags risks early and brings solutions instead of waiting to be asked.
Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with comfort engaging strategic client stakeholders.
Language & Location: Professional fluency in English and Spanish; right to work in Mexico.
Degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience.
Hands-on experience with programmatic deal setups (PMPs, PG deals) and self-service ad platforms.
Prior experience identifying incremental revenue opportunities within existing accounts.
Experience with work management tools (e.g., Monday) and with building client-ready reports and presentations.
Meaningful scope & real ownership — work with trusted autonomy and direct impact on client outcomes in Mexico.
Global exposure and genuinely complex challenges at real scale — reaching over 2.2 billion users monthly across 18 billion ad opportunities daily.
Smart, ambitious peers across 30+ markets in a collaborative, cross-border setup.
A genuinely human culture — high care alongside high accountability.
Real investment in your growth — structured mentorship, coaching, courses, workshops, and development programs.

Plan and execute quarterly incremental revenue prospecting plans in close collaboration with the Sales team.
Contribute to internal team development through consistent knowledge sharing and operational best practice exercises.

Core Experience: 2 to 3+ years of relevant experience within a digital media agency, publisher, SSP, DSP, or AdTech company.

title: Media Executive UVM
description:
Descripción de la empresa

Publicis Groupe México es una destacada agencia de publicidad y comunicación integral que ofrece

soluciones creativas y estratégicas en marketing digital, medios y relaciones públicas. Parte del

conglomerado global Publicis Groupe, se especializa en innovar y conectar marcas con sus audiencias a

través de campañas efectivas y tecnología avanzada.

Descripción del puesto

Apoyar en la implementación, seguimiento, optimización y cierre de campañas de medios, asegurando el cumplimiento de los planes aprobados, el control administrativo de la inversión y la entrega puntual de reportes. La posición coordina actividades con equipos internos, clientes, plataformas y proveedores para mantener una operación ordenada y orientada a resultados.

Responsabilidades

Implementar campañas de medios digitales y, cuando aplique, apoyar ejecuciones integradas con medios tradicionales.

Enfoque de la vacante: Principalmente medios offline, más que online.

Dar seguimiento a presupuestos, pacing, calendarios, materiales, especificaciones y entregables de campaña.

Cargar y actualizar órdenes de compra, planes, modificaciones y cierres en sistemas internos o ERP de medios.

Coordinar solicitudes con plataformas, publishers, proveedores, equipos de planeación, finanzas y servicio al cliente.

Monitorear KPIs de campaña e identificar desviaciones u oportunidades de optimización para escalar al supervisor.

Preparar, validar y actualizar reportes de campaña, post-buy, bases de competencia y presentaciones de resultados.

Asegurar la precisión de la información en sistemas, reportes y controles administrativos.

Dar seguimiento a conciliaciones, facturación, documentación y cierres de inversión con proveedores y equipos internos.

Participar en reuniones de estatus y comunicar riesgos, pendientes y avances de manera clara y oportuna.

Cumplir procesos, tiempos y estándares de calidad, respondiendo con agilidad ante cambios de prioridad.

Cualificaciones

Licenciatura concluida en Mercadotecnia, Publicidad, Comunicación, Administración o carrera afín.

1 a 3 años de experiencia en agencia de medios, publicidad, marketing o áreas relacionadas.

Experiencia en implementación, seguimiento y cierre de campañas.

Manejo intermedio de Excel y PowerPoint; capacidad para trabajar con bases de datos, reportes y presentaciones.

Comprensión de inglés de aproximadamente 80%.

Información adicional

En Publicis Groupe valoramos la diversidad y estamos comprometidos con la creación de un entorno de trabajo inclusivo para todas las personas. No discriminamos por motivos de raza, color, religión, sexo, identidad o expresión de género, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad, estado civil, nacionalidad o cualquier otra condición protegida por la ley.

Creemos que la diversidad impulsa la innovación y fortalece nuestros equipos. Por ello, promovemos la igualdad de oportunidades y tomamos todas las decisiones de empleo con base en las capacidades, experiencia, mérito y necesidades del negocio, garantizando siempre un trato respetuoso y digno para colaboradores y candidatos.

Asimismo, reconocemos la importancia de la flexibilidad laboral y promovemos un esquema de trabajo híbrido que permite combinar el trabajo remoto y presencial, favoreciendo el bienestar de nuestros colaboradores sin comprometer la excelencia en el servicio que brindamos a nuestros clientes.

description:
Type: Full-Time, Remote, EST business hours




About Venveo

Venveo is a fast-growing digital marketing agency helping home service brands grow and thrive online. From HVAC and roofing to landscaping and remodeling, we partner with companies that are experts at what they do — and we make sure they get seen, booked, and remembered.




The Role

We’re looking for a Local SEO Specialist with experience in home service-based industries to lead Local SEO across our client portfolio.




This is a hands-on leadership role: you will execute high-impact SEO work, leverage support resources where appropriate, and refine the standards, processes, and playbooks for Local SEO delivery. Over time, you will help build and grow the Local SEO department, setting the vision for how Venveo delivers local search results for our clients.




Your success in this role will be measured by:

Client Performance

Improvements in Map Grid rankings and local pack visibility
Growth in Google Business Profile visibility, actions, and leads
Increased website traffic from local and organic search
Increased website leads and conversions

Operational Leadership

Establishing clear, repeatable Local SEO processes and standards
Effectively executing high-impact SEO work while delegating recurring tasks
Maintaining quality and consistency across all client accounts
Contributing to the growth and maturity of the Local SEO function at Venveo




Responsibilities

Lead and conduct technical and content SEO audits to identify site issues and opportunities across client accounts.
Own keyword research and local search strategy to inform content and optimization plans.
Create content and optimization calendars aligned with keyword strategy and business goals.
Optimize existing and new content according to SEO best practices and AI-readiness standards.
Create or refine content using Surfer SEO or similar tools for priority pages and clients.
Own Google Business Profile optimization, ensuring accurate NAP data, citation consistency, and ongoing GBP performance.
Oversee citation building and directory accuracy using BrightLocal or similar tools, leveraging support resources where appropriate.
Track SEO performance, keyword movement, and local search impact using ProRankTracker, GSC, and Looker Studio dashboards.
Implement and oversee on-site SEO improvements within CMS platforms (WordPress, Squarespace, Wix).
Stay ahead of SEO trends, including AI-driven search changes, AEO, and local SERP shifts, and evolve Venveo’s approach accordingly.
Optimize local and on-page content for AI and answer engines, ensuring visibility in voice, conversational, and location-based search results.
Deliver monthly reports with actionable insights focused on lead generation, conversions, and measurable business impact.
Collaborate closely with Executive Strategist, Producer, Project Coordinator, and support resources to ensure smooth workflows, clear communication, and strong client delivery.




Tools We Use

Must be proficient in:

Google Search Console
Google Analytics
Google My Business
WordPress, Squarespace, Wix
SEMrush, Ahrefs or Screaming Frog




Preferred experience with:

Surfer SEO
BrightLocal
Looker Studio
ProRankTracker




Key Skills:

Deep expertise in Local SEO and familiarity with AEO and GEO principles.
Proven ability to conduct technical SEO audits and implement on-site recommendations that drive measurable results.
Skilled in leveraging structured data, FAQs, and conversational content to enhance local search visibility across Google and AI-driven search.
Strong experience managing multiple client accounts, balancing execution, oversight, and client communication.
Clear and effective communicator, able to explain SEO strategies and insights to clients and internal teams.
Experienced in creating, documenting, and standardizing repeatable SEO processes for audits, optimizations, and reporting.
Capable of leading, delegating, and building a Local SEO function, while still rolling up sleeves to execute high-impact work.




Why Venveo

We value sharp thinkers, a results-driven mindset, and people who take ownership from start to finish. At Venveo, you’ll have the opportunity to lead Local SEO for client accounts, make a measurable impact, and help shape the growth of our SEO function — all while being part of a collaborative, high-performing team.

description:
We’re hiring a Recruitment Marketing Manager to attract qualified candidates through social media, paid campaigns, and other channels across Latin America.




About Viva Talent




Viva Talent connects US companies with exceptional Executive Assistants and creates meaningful, career-defining work for talented people across Latin America. We’re a globally distributed team of 200+ people across 15+ countries and 3 continents, on a mission to expand real opportunity for women in LATAM.




Why we’re opening this role




We’re opening this role to make candidate generation more consistent as Viva’s hiring needs grow. We need a builder-minded manager who can set up and drive a recruitment marketing strategy, using social media, paid campaigns, and other channels to attract qualified candidates and help us broaden our mission to empower more women in LATAM to access meaningful job opportunities.




Responsibilities




Lead candidate demand generation: Build and manage a multi-channel strategy to attract candidates, with social media as a core channel.
Generate candidate leads and applications: Develop campaigns that grow qualified candidate volume and improve results using performance data.
Own paid campaigns end to end: Identify campaign needs, analyze the audience and opportunity, build and create ads, launch campaigns, measure their impact, and optimize performance.
Create and coordinate content: Develop original organic social content and coordinate staff- or influencer-generated content initiatives as relevant.
Build an effective function: Identify the processes, channels, tools, and partner support needed to make candidate generation scalable.
Start hands-on and grow into leadership: Begin as the sole recruitment marketing contributor, personally developing and running the work. As the function grows, take on people management and lead and new team members.




Requirements




Marketing management: 3+ years in a marketing manager role, including at least 2 years with people management responsibilities.
Demand generation and results: Experience building a multi-channel strategy and increasing lead or application volume through campaigns. Use performance data to improve results and connect campaigns to pipeline impact, hires, and post-hire quality. Candidate-generation experience is ideal; customer or user lead generation is transferable (B2C preferred).
End-to-end paid campaigns: Assess campaign needs and audiences, build and create ads, launch campaigns, analyze impact, and optimize results. Hands-on experience with LinkedIn, Meta, and TikTok.
Organic social content: Create consistent, original content that attracts candidates and encourages them to learn more or apply.
AI, automation, and systems: Use LLMs, tools such as Zapier or n8n, and vibe-coding tools such as Lovable to improve workflows. CRM experience is relevant. Bring original ideas and make independent creative decisions.
Communication: C1+ English, with clear, confident, concise written and verbal communication.




Nice to have: Recruitment marketing, Talent Acquisition, employer brand, candidate-generation, or B2C experience; staff- or influencer-generated content experience; Google or AEO experience.




Location

Remote, based in Argentina, Honduras, Guatemala, El Salvador, Costa Rica, Nicaragua, Colombia, Ecuador, or Mexico.




Benefits




100% remote work, forever.
Competitive compensation with increases every six months and performance bonuses.
Global health insurance, including medical, dental, vision, mental health, and routine care.
Paid holidays, vacation, sick leave, and family care days.
Parental leave and flexible support.
A culture centered around growth, ownership, well-being, and continuous learning.




How we hire




A focused process: application → recruiter screen → skills assessment → hiring-manager interview → final interview. We move quickly and respect your time.




🔎 Important Notice: All Viva communication will come from an @execviva.com email. If you receive messages from unofficial sources (e.g., Instagram, Facebook), please report them to careers@execviva.com. We never request payments or personal information from candidates.

description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The Company Is Founder Led, Profitable And Growing.

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators. They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories, and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities, and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

As an experienced marketer at Canonical, you’ll lead cross-disciplinary teams of product, partner, or sales professionals in your specific area, from establishing priorities and strategies with senior stakeholders to delivering on integrated campaigns. We are looking for both generalists who want to take ownership of a product portfolio or channel, and for specialists who can help the whole team excel in their domain of expertise.

Location: This is a globally remote role; you can be based in EMEA, APAC, or the Americas, depending on the team’s location.

The role entails

You will take ownership of one of our core marketing tracks and lead both strategy and execution. You’ll ensure campaigns land, launches succeed, and adoption grows, while contributing to the broader go-to-market engine.

You will:


Lead GTM strategy and campaign execution in your functional area
Align with product, sales, content, and partner teams to deliver integrated plans
Shape messaging, positioning, and assets that resonate with customers
Design and run experiments to test your hypothesis
Drive major launches, marketing initiatives, and growth programs
Run reviews and retrospectives to improve performance and impact
Mentor colleagues, strengthen the function, and set high standards for delivery



What we are looking for in you


Strong written and verbal communication in English
Exceptional academic track record from high school and university
Proven experience in B2B marketing, ideally in software, SaaS, or open source
Strong track record shaping go-to-market strategy, messaging, and campaigns that move the pipeline
Fast adaptation to change and new technology adoption in marketing
A leader, growing and elevating others across the organization 
A solid eye for ROI and effective budget management
Ability to influence and align stakeholders across the organization
Excellent communication and storytelling skills for technical solutions
Skilled at managing complex projects and leading cross-functional teams
Comfortable using data to evaluate campaigns and refine strategy
Proactive, outcome-driven, and confident, operating independently at a global scale



Nice-to-have skills


Background in sales-led or ecosystem growth
Familiarity with ABM (Account-Based Marketing) approaches
Experience leading go-to-market efforts across a large product portfolio
Experience managing budgets, agencies, or external vendors
Understanding of open source communities and business models
Experience mentoring or leading junior marketers



What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilization. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

🏠Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

📚Personal learning and development budget of 2,000 USD per annum

💰Annual compensation review

🏆Recognition rewards

🏝 Annual holiday leave

👶Parental Leave

🧑‍💼Employee Assistance Programme

🧳Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Ethnik Living is a Los Angeles-based furniture and home décor brand offering distinctive, thoughtfully designed pieces for residential and commercial spaces across the United States.




Role

We're looking for a Senior Creative Strategist to own and develop performance-driven creative strategies across our product categories and digital advertising channels.

You'll turn consumer insights, competitive research, and advertising performance data into compelling creative concepts, then guide their execution from initial idea to final asset.




Key Responsibilities

Creative Strategy & Category Ownership

Own creative strategy across assigned product categories, from customer research and concept development to testing and performance analysis.
Develop new concepts, messaging angles, target audiences, formats, and testing priorities.
Develop campaign concepts for product launches, evergreen acquisition, seasonal promotions, and remarketing.




Creative Development & Production

Write compelling hooks, UGC scripts, video concepts, storyboards, and creative briefs.
Guide creative development across static ads, short-form video, product demonstrations, and lifestyle content.
Review creative assets and provide clear, constructive feedback to improve execution.
Collaborate with Growth, Graphic Design, Product, and Branding Teams.




Performance Analysis & Optimization

Analyze campaign performance using metrics including hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS, and conversion rate.
Identify winning creative patterns, underperforming concepts, and opportunities for iteration.
Build structured testing plans for creative angles, hooks, formats, and messaging.
Use performance insights to inform future creative production and improve advertising effectiveness.
Conduct competitor creative research and analyze customer reviews, feedback, and market trends.




Requirements

What we're looking for

3+ years of hands-on creative strategy experience in DTC e-commerce or performance advertising.
Proven experience developing creative strategies for US-facing consumer brands.
Strong understanding of Meta advertising and performance creative best practices.
Demonstrated ability to develop UGC concepts, scripts, creative briefs, and testing frameworks.
Experience working with designers, video editors, and content creators.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate advertising data into creative decisions.
Excellent understanding of consumer psychology, brand positioning, and direct-response marketing.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong US-market copywriting skills.
A proactive, organized approach and the ability to manage multiple creative projects independently.
A portfolio or case studies demonstrating creative strategy ownership and measurable results.




Nice to Have

Experience with furniture, interior design, home décor, lifestyle, or premium consumer brands.
Experience with higher-ticket or considered-purchase products.
Experience coordinating creator-led or influencer advertising campaigns.
Familiarity with Shopify and e-commerce customer journeys.
Experience working in a fast-growing international brand or agency environment.




Tech Stack

Experience with the following tools or equivalent platforms is valuable:

Meta Ads Manager and Meta Ads Library
Motion, Northbeam, or similar creative analytics tools
Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
Foreplay
Canva
Shopify Analytics
Adobe Creative Cloud
Frame.io or equivalent creative review tools
ChatGPT, Claude, or comparable AI tools
TikTok Creative Center

 and other creative research platforms




Location: Remote 

Contract Type: Contract

Compensation: 3,000–5,000 USD per month

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Help define and amplify the Stripe story and connect our products with our users.

Our Product Marketing team’s mission is to generate insights that inform Stripe’s product strategy, lead go-to-market for our suite of products, and create and execute campaigns that drive product growth. Product Marketing is a highly cross-functional role at Stripe, partnering closely with Product and Engineering, Sales, Design, Developer Relations, and Communications. Unlike many other Product Marketing teams, our team works across the entire product lifecycle—from helping shape the product, to driving launch and commercialization, to growing product adoption after launch.

What you’ll do

As the regional product marketing lead for Latin America, you will champion the needs of users across the region and help define and develop a strong, trusted brand in the market. You will connect product, sales, and marketing to support Stripe’s growth while delivering successful user outcomes. Based in Mexico City, you will bring deep regional insight to Stripe’s product strategy and go-to-market execution across Latin America.

Responsibilities


Lead the delivery of regional product marketing priorities that drive growth for businesses across Latin America with a focus on Mexico, in close partnership with Product, go-to-market, and Marketing teams
Develop deep expertise in the needs of current and prospective users through user research, competitive landscape analysis, and product knowledge
Develop, deploy, and maintain market-specific value propositions, narratives, and messaging for marketing content, campaigns, and sales collateral
Drive high-quality product launches and adoption by partnering with Product, Sales, Engineering, Marketing, Design, Communications, Partnerships, and other cross-functional teams
Improve seller effectiveness across the region through product and solution training, market-specific content and tools, and field support
Monitor indicators of product adoption, usage, and satisfaction to identify barriers and opportunities across the regional growth funnel
Partner with country and regional marketing teams to develop content programs for priority events, integrated campaigns, and ongoing demand generation



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


8+ years of experience in B2B technology marketing or sales, including product marketing experience
Experience developing value propositions, messaging, go-to-market strategies, and sales materials for multiple markets or customer segments
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and building alignment with senior stakeholders across Product, Sales, and Marketing
High professional fluency in Spanish and English, as this role will develop market-specific messaging and work with users and internal teams across Latin America
Ability to travel domestically and internationally for business



Preferred Qualifications


Experience marketing technology products or services across Latin America
Experience in payments, financial services, or financial technology
Experience working in a global technology company with distributed teams



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Director, CA&E Products

About The Job

Our Purpose

We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results.

Job Title

Director – Consumer Acquisition and Engagement, Product

Overview

Mastercard’s Services organization is a key growth engine, delivering innovative solutions that help our customers thrive. By integrating proprietary data, cutting-edge technology, expert insights, and strategic expertise, Services plays a critical role in driving Mastercard’s differentiation and business growth. We work side by side with our clients as a key lever to help grow their business through innovative, scalable, and technology-enabled solutions.

Within the Services organization, Consumer Acquisition & Engagement places Mastercard at the heart of our customers’ B2C and B2B lifecycle management strategies. We help our customers acquire, engage, and retain consumers through end-to-end services, platforms, and marketing solutions.

Role

The Consumer Acquisition & Engagement (CA&E) team focuses on products and solutions that address dynamic market needs. We are seeking a Regional Director – CA&E Products for North LAC to lead the go-to-market strategy, commercialization agenda, market expansion of innovative Loyalty solutions and drive Offers across the division.

This role will shape regional growth by identifying market opportunities, defining differentiated product narratives, and enabling sales teams with scalable commercialization strategies. The Director will serve as a senior strategic partner across regional and global product, sales, account management, and market teams to accelerate adoption and business impact.

The ideal candidate brings broad experience across digital marketing, media strategy, and media agency engagement, with strong expertise in integrated campaign planning, audience strategy, performance measurement, and commercialization. This individual should be equally comfortable driving executive-level strategy, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and translating market and client needs into compelling growth opportunities.

 Drive regional growth by leading the commercialization strategy for CA&E solutions across North LAC, with a focus on Marketing, Personalization, and data-driven customer engagement capabilities.

 Develop compelling product narratives, value propositions, and sales enablement materials tailored to different customer segments, industries, and market contexts.
 Partner closely with Sales, Account Management, and Product teams to support strategic client engagements, commercial proposals, and high-impact RFP responses.
 Lead scalable 1:M commercialization initiatives, including regional campaigns, thought leadership, training, and tools that expand awareness and accelerate pipeline generation.
 Translate client, market, and competitive insights into recommendations that influence product evolution, roadmap prioritization, and regional growth strategy.
 Establish clear success metrics and measurement frameworks to evaluate commercialization effectiveness, campaign performance, and business impact.
 Influence and align cross-functional, matrixed teams across regional and global stakeholders, driving clarity, focus, and execution excellence.



All About You


 +10 years’ experience in product marketing, media, marketing strategy, or related roles, with a strong track record of driving growth in complex and dynamic markets.
 Broad experience in media and media agencies, including exposure to integrated media planning, performance marketing, audience strategy, measurement, and agency collaboration models.
 Strong business acumen and strategic thinking, with the ability to connect customer needs, market dynamics, and commercial opportunities into actionable growth plans.
 Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders within highly matrixed, international organizations.
 Deep knowledge of digital marketing, loyalty, consumer engagement, and personalization, with the ability to translate technical or platform capabilities into client value.
 Experience developing go-to-market strategies, sales enablement programs, and customer-facing narratives that support adoption and commercialization at scale.
 Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with comfort interpreting performance signals, market intelligence, and business metrics to guide decisions.
 Exceptional storytelling, communication, and executive presence, with the ability to influence, inspire, and simplify complex concepts for varied audiences.
 Creative, proactive, and solution-oriented, with the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, evolving environments.
 International and regional experience within matrixed organizations is highly desirable.



Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Shape What Comes Next

At Coursera, our Data Science team is helping to build the future of education through data-driven decision making and data-powered products. We believe the next generation of teaching and learning should be personalized, accessible, and efficient. Our ideal candidate possesses strong analytical skills, business acumen, and a deep understanding of marketing and product principles, along with the ability to translate analysis into actionable recommendations.
