title: Senior Market Research Analyst, Client Services
description:
Mexico, Remote

Konovo is a global healthcare intelligence company transforming research through technology, enabling faster, better, connected insights. We provide healthcare organizations with real-time access to over 2 million healthcare professionals and patients, the largest network of its kind in the world. Our 300+ employees span 25 U.S. states and five countries, collaborating to support some of the largest organizations in the healthcare industry. Our customers include over 300 leading global pharmaceutical, medical device, market research agency, and consultancy companies.

As we shift to a more product and technology-driven organization, our team’s work to provide best-in-class services to our customers is more important than ever before, and we are expanding our remote Client Services team in Mexico. We’re looking for a Senior Market Research Analyst to own high-quality project execution that keeps our life sciences and healthcare clients growing. This is a chance to shape how a fast-growing, product-led company runs research, not just execute someone else’s process.

How You’ll Make an Impact

Program and field research using Konovo’s proprietary technology to reach the right client audiences

Own daily data collection and quality review across 10–20+ surveys a month, or roughly 8–10 active projects a week

Partner with our Global Sample Fulfillment team to complete fieldwork across U.S. and international markets, managing sample quota goals

Turn raw data into comprehensive, client-ready research reports for large-scale and global pharmaceutical clients, with findings and recommendations that actually get used

Act as a trusted research partner to clients, translating complex ideas into clear, decision-ready deliverables

Keep research compliant: complete required adverse event (AE) training, monitor for AEs, and report them to pharmacovigilance on strict internal and manufacturer timelines

Keep our internal project management portal current and accurate for all live projects

What We’re Looking For

2+ years in market research, insights, analytics, or a related research role (healthcare/life sciences exposure strongly preferred)

Strong quantitative analysis skills: comfortable designing and writing quantitative surveys, analyzing data, and drawing out actionable trends, with strong command of Excel for analysis and PowerPoint for client-ready reporting

Direct experience with survey programming tools (Confirmit, Decipher/Forsta, SurveyMonkey, or similar)

Sharp attention to detail across research design, logistics, and project management, with a proactive, independent problem-solving style

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the polish to represent Konovo directly to global pharma clients

Curiosity to dig into client business questions across multiple therapeutic areas

Adaptable under tight timelines, able to juggle multiple complex projects at once

Bachelor’s degree in social sciences, market research, health sciences/public health, or equivalent experience

Available to work U.S. East Coast hours (EST)

Comfortable leveraging, and helping to inform the development of AI-enabled tools to transform workflows, improve response quality and timeliness, and deliver growth at scale without compromising data integrity or customer experience.

Why Konovo

Work on cutting-edge, AI-powered solutions transforming healthcare insights

Be part of a mission-driven company reshaping how healthcare decisions get made

Join a fast-growing global team with real career advancement

Thrive in a remote, collaborative environment that values innovation and flexibility

Make a real-world impact helping healthcare organizations move faster

If you’re eager to build a meaningful career in healthcare market research, and you’re smart, nice, and driven to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior Revops Engineer
description:
About Improvado Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams.

We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI.

Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies.

You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured.

That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from.

You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change.

You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do Salesforce and GTM stack Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).

Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes.

Manage licences and vendor renewals.

Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.

Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance.

Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.

Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).

Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.

Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes.

Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.

Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.

Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product.

Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands‑on admin of a live Salesforce org.

Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric).

dbt is a plus.

Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.

Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.

Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.

Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.

ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.

Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.

Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.

HubSpot to Salesforce migration.

Attribution or CS health score data.

Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer Remote-first environment Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises 20 working days of PTO per year US holidays and additional days off Professional development reimbursement

title: Senior Revops Engineer
description:
About Improvado Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams.

We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI.

Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies.

You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured.

That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from.

You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change.

You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do Salesforce and GTM stack Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).

Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes.

Manage licences and vendor renewals.

Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.

Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance.

Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.

Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).

Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.

Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes.

Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.

Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.

Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product.

Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands‑on admin of a live Salesforce org.

Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric).

dbt is a plus.

Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.

Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.

Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.

Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.

ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.

Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.

Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.

HubSpot to Salesforce migration.

Attribution or CS health score data.

Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer Remote-first environment Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises 20 working days of PTO per year US holidays and additional days off Professional development reimbursement

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. Offering spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken Pro is where serious traders work. Tight spreads, deep books, an API people actually build on. The people who use it are demanding, opinionated, and allergic to marketing.

We want someone who belongs in that room. Not a brand account with a person behind it, but a trader's trader who happens to be very good at building community.

Come here to build and grow this Community for us.

The opportunity


Live in the trenches. Discord, Telegram, X, TradingView, Reddit, the group chats you're already in at 3am. You're not "monitoring channels". You're a participant, with standing.

Write things people screenshot. Threads on microstructure, teardowns of new features, release notes that don't read like release notes.
Prove it worked. Sentiment, share of voice, community-sourced signups, retention of the accounts that matter. You bring the numbers to the table before anyone asks.


What You’ll Bring


You trade. Actual positions, actual scars. You can hold a conversation about funding rates, maker/taker economics, slippage, and latency without reaching for a glossary.
3+ years running community or social for a product with a technical, skeptical audience. Crypto, fintech, gaming, or dev tools all count.

We are seeking an experienced and influential Developer Relations professional to become a trusted public voice and brand ambassador within the developer ecosystem. In this role, you will leverage your established presence on Twitter (X) to engage with developers, share valuable technical insights, and strengthen the company's visibility and reputation. You will contribute to conversations around emerging technologies, product launches, and the future of software development. Working closely with Developer Relations, Marketing, and Product teams, you will help shape communication strategies and amplify the developer community's voice. You will also represent the organization at industry events, podcasts, and other public engagements. This is an exciting opportunity for a recognized technical communicator to make a meaningful impact in a globally distributed, developer-first environment.

Accountabilities


Build and maintain a visible, credible, and engaging presence on Twitter (X), actively representing the brand through regular posts, replies, and meaningful interactions with the developer community.
Create and share high-quality content, including product announcements, technical insights, practical tips, industry opinions, and perspectives on emerging development trends.
Participate in relevant developer discussions and contribute to conversations that strengthen brand awareness, credibility, and community engagement.
Represent the organization at industry events, conferences, podcasts, and other public-facing opportunities, both online and in person.
Gather valuable feedback, questions, and insights from developers and communicate them to engineering and product teams to help inform product improvements.
Collaborate with New Media, Developer Relations, Product Marketing, and other internal teams to support product launches and communication initiatives.
Help shape the organization's public voice and positioning within the broader developer ecosystem.


Requirements


Proven experience in a senior Developer Relations, Developer Advocacy, or similar developer-facing position.
An established and engaged Twitter (X) following, with demonstrated credibility and influence within the developer community. Evaluation will consider audience engagement, the quality of interactions, and the relevance of your network, not just follower numbers.
Strong technical knowledge and the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly, accurately, and engagingly to technical audiences.
Excellent writing skills, with a distinctive personal voice and the ability to create compelling, insightful, and relevant content.
Confidence and experience representing an organization publicly across social media, video, podcasts, conferences, and industry events.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build authentic relationships and engage effectively with developers and industry professionals.
A proactive, self-directed mindset, with strong ownership, initiative, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Comfortable collaborating across distributed teams and managing priorities in an asynchronous work environment.


Benefits


Fully Remote Work: Work from anywhere in the world, with no requirement to work from a physical office.
Co-working Allowance: Access to a WeWork membership or co-working budget to support your preferred working environment.
Equity Ownership (ESOP): Receive company equity and participate in the long-term growth and success of the organization.
Technology Allowance: Dedicated budget to purchase equipment and tools, including laptops, monitors, headphones, and other work essentials.
Health Insurance: 100% of employee health insurance premiums covered, with 80% coverage for eligible dependents, regardless of location.
Annual Company Off-Sites: Join colleagues from around the world for a week of collaboration, networking, and team activities in a different city each year.
Flexible Working Arrangements: Enjoy an asynchronous working culture with the autonomy to organize your schedule and manage your responsibilities.
Professional Development: Annual learning allowance to invest in courses, books, conferences, and other professional growth opportunities.
Global Team Environment: Collaborate with an international team spanning more than 60 countries and 20 languages, within a thriving open-source and developer-focused ecosystem.

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

 Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. description:
About Us

At WeWork, we provide flexible workspace solutions to help businesses of all sizes thrive in more than 37 countries worldwide. The future of work is here, and we’re not just a part of that movement—we’re leading it. United by a desire to build a global community, our purpose is to give members the support to do their best work, and the space to take their ideas to new heights. Join us as we empower tomorrow’s world at work.

Community Associate | Community

About The Opportunity

As a Community Associate, you'll be the primary point of contact for the Community and act as the “face” of WeWork! You will report to your building each day to support the Community Management team.

Duties

Your work, which will include but not be limited to the duties listed below, will help WeWork to achieve the following:


Build a welcoming and collaborative community environment amongst our members through events and building relationships between members!
Ensure that your building is fully operational and processes are running efficiently.
Drive growth and promotion of WeWork-provided service offerings.
Take direction from the Community Lead and the Community Manager to support the Community Team as necessary.
All of this while illustrating WeWork’s core values and working towards achieving our mission.


Depending on the location you are assigned, you’ll either work with a variety of members from different backgrounds and industries, or focus your efforts on one of our Enterprise clients. Employees supporting our Enterprise locations may have different holidays, technical systems, operational and relationship requirements, and property management responsibilities than employees in our Classic locations.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for the following areas: 

Front Desk Management


Cover the front desk during the building’s set business hours and be an on-site point of contact, easily located on the member floor or at Community Bar.
Greet members and guests with a warm and welcoming demeanor.
Ensure all visiting guests are in accordance with WeWork's guest policy by ensuring all guests properly sign-in via Welkio tablet.
Learn the names of members and guests with the goal of building relationships in order to facilitate the sense of Community WeWork is known for.
Anticipate member and guest needs before they arise using relevant information collected about members to enhance and personalize their experience.
Ensure building Specific forms are up to date including pet forms, filming requests, bike room requests, etc.
Keep the front desk clean and organized.
Notify members of any food deliveries and couriers.
Answer any questions from members and guests related to the building including way-finding, policies and procedures, community etiquette, etc.


Events And Membership Engagement


Provide feedback on programming types (based on member makeup) and evaluate events based on attendance, satisfaction, and impact on the appropriate event team.
Consistently celebrate members’ successes and milestones through gifts and notes.
Distribute all necessary info to promote the event including creation and posting of weekly events poster and individual event posters.
Ensure building-specific operational requirements are met for each event (elevators, HVAC, etc).
Input notes into Kube or equivalent system about Members.
Identify and execute opportunities to connect members with each other.
Know and recommend local restaurants, food delivery services, catering options, team outing venues, post office, shipping center, supply store, etc.
Be active on the WeWork member network to engage members.
Know and explain WeWork policies and procedures and communicate, inform, and update members on building issues.
Ensure music levels and activations are appropriate to the daypart and occasion.
Write and send broadcasts relating to building updates.


Building Operations And Management


Receive, process, sort, and organize all mail.
Locate and issue posts via the regional system to members upon request.
Keep the mailroom organized and clean.
“Return to Sender" for unidentified mail and former member mail after 30 days of no-pick up.
Ensure courier parcels have all the correct details for scheduled pick-ups.
Investigate, escalate, and resolve 'lost' packages.
Know and explain WeWork policies and procedures around mail and mailroom.
Track, audit, and organize keys collected and distributed.
Manage keycard stock and request new inventory as needed.
Collect keys and key cards upon move-out.
Review location and how to use each piece of Emergency Equipment.
Provide support for an automated coffee machine for guests and members.


About You

We’d love to hear from you if you meet the qualifications below:


College graduate with a four-year degree preferred, but not required
1+ years of hospitality experience
Customer service and/or sales experience a plus
Must have strong verbal and written communication skills
Outstanding interpersonal and multitasking skills
Demonstrate integrity, dependability, responsibility, accountability, self-awareness, work ethic, and compassion
Passion for entrepreneurial communities
Passion and understanding of WeWork’s mission and values
Proficient in basic computer skills


Life at WeWork

Being a WeWorker is more than just a job. We believe the magic of work is sparked by the passion you bring, the places you go, the people you meet and the purpose you follow. And it starts here. Here you will brush shoulders with those who dare to dream and do. Here you will be welcomed by a community that embraces and inspires you—because together we can achieve more. Here we challenge ideas, and explore new ways of getting things done. Whether you are part of our Employee Community Groups, or part of a global project, we ask you to bring your open-minded attitude and collaborative spirit. In return, you will be part of a team where your unique perspectives are celebrated.

description:
Description

Are you passionate about music, entertainment, and building creative partnerships that drive growth at scale? Do you excel at identifying actionable insights that translate into growth initiatives? Amazon Music is seeking a Partner Growth Manager to execute partnership growth strategies. This role will own the end-to-end partnership marketing lifecycle — from planning through execution — working closely with internal teams and external partners to drive new audience growth, customer acquisition, engagement, and retention for Amazon Music.

For someone to be successful in this role, they need to embody the following:

Growth Marketing Executor: They must be a marketing professional with experience in partner-focused growth marketing. They execute growth strategies in ambiguous environments, use their knowledge and skills to decide which actions to take to meet goals, and design short-term solutions with limited guidance. Their work is tactical, and they are learning to be strategic.

Cross-Functional Influencer: They influence across external partners, internal teams, and geographies to deliver outcomes. They build consensus across diverse functions (Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Business Development) and present recommendations to leadership.

Relationship Builder: They excel at fostering and maintaining strong relationships across all levels — from partner contacts to internal stakeholders — demonstrating strong communication skills and the ability to earn trust and influence.

Data-Driven Decision Maker: They have a natural curiosity for analytics and metrics, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights. They dive deep into performance data to identify trends and optimize campaign performance across the customer lifecycle.

Results Oriented & Operationally Excellent: They take ownership and drive initiatives from concept to completion, mitigating immediate risks and making trade-offs between time, quality, and resources. They identify and optimize process improvements for the team to drive outputs and sustained growth impact.

Key job responsibilities


 Execute partner marketing and growth strategies for Amazon Music partners, delivering against customer acquisition, engagement, and retention goals
 Own and execute go-to-market plans for partner launches for growth marketing efforts, including planning, execution, analysis/reporting, and optimization
 Continually optimize partnerships from launch through ongoing sustaining efforts to maximize offer discoverability, frequency in communications, share of voice, and identifying new opportunities within existing partnerships
 Implement and launch partner campaigns with the goal of delivering creative excellence that represents the Amazon Music brand and drives awareness through partners
 Dive deep into data to understand insights and learnings that inform strategy; manage performance reporting for partners and share market intelligence with stakeholders and teammates
 Collaborate cross-functionally across Product, BI/Data Science, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Business Development to deliver best-in-class campaign opportunities and assets for partners
 Identify and suggest process improvements to drive operational efficiency of the team and maximize impact
 Function at a global level, sharing best practices and scaling programs or campaigns that benefit multiple regions
 Experiment with new approaches to drive partnership success and raise the bar on growth marketing innovation


Basic Qualifications


 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Experience building and optimizing multiple, simultaneous marketing campaigns
 Experience managing projects in a fast pace environment
 Experience aggregating and analyzing internal and external campaign metrics to assess performance drivers and identify insights
 Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
 Experience in ownership of projects and communicating timelines and executing independently
 Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
 5+ years of experience in growth marketing or partnership marketing across industries such as music, entertainment, media, mobile, telecommunications, retail, or financial services


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint
 Experience in the entertainment industry, preferably within Podcasts or Music
 Experience in global and/or centralized partnership or growth marketing teams
 Experience creating centralized programs that can be leveraged on a global scale
 Experience working across multiple geographies and cultures

title: TikTok Shop Affiliate Manager
description:
About SocialTale

SocialTale is a TikTok Shop specialist agency and official TikTok Shop Agency Partner. We work with DTC brands across the US, UK and EU to grow affiliate-driven GMV through creator recruitment, campaign execution and hands-on shop ops.

Role summary

We are hiring an Affiliate Manager to sit inside a delivery pod and run the creator engine for US TikTok Shop brands. You will find the right creators, build the relationships, keep them posting, and own the affiliate numbers that feed client and pod reporting. This seat needs someone who can work US business hours from Mexico, Brazil or Argentina.

What you will own

Identify, outreach and onboard creators who fit brand categories and campaign goals (TikTok, Cruva, FastMoss and referrals)

Build and manage active creator relationships: briefing, negotiation, retention and re-warming between launches

Coordinate creator activity around product launches, flash sales and promo windows

Manage sample approvals against brand thresholds and follow through sample-to-post

Track affiliate GMV, activation, video output and conversion; flag what works and cut what does not

Keep creator lists, CRM and tiers accurate; feed a clear weekly affiliate read into pod and client updates

Work with the strategist on briefs, positioning and content direction

Speak with clients on Slack, email and calls when affiliate performance needs explaining

Requirements

At least 1 year hands-on TikTok Shop experience (affiliate, creator management or shop management)

Fluent English, written and spoken

Confident speaking with clients and creators on calls, not only async

Highly organised; able to run many creator relationships and campaigns at once

Comfortable with performance data and spreadsheets

Strong grasp of TikTok and the creator landscape

Based in Mexico, Brazil or Argentina and able to cover US business hours (Eastern preferred)

Nice to have

Agency experience

Experience with retainer creators, Spark codes and flash-sale alignment

Familiarity with Cruva, FastMoss or similar creator research tools
